notes.title: Version Update 1.0.3f0
notes.notes:
Hey revolutionaries! The November update is here as promised.
We are excited to announce that we have completed all work listed on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1220010/announcements/detail/3106916883155694882]previously published roadmap[/url]. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Home Behind 2!

The v1.0.3f0 update includes:

[b]- 1 new side mission: Challenge Psychic Agent, a new boss class, to earn special armor rewards.[/b]
[quote]How to unlock this quest:
[olist][*]Complete Secret Base, the first main mission.
[*]Arrive at an area with a Danger of 4 or higher.
[*]Explore 15 or more areas (chance to spawn side mission increases with each area explored; explore 25 areas for a 100% chance).[/olist]
Mission path:
[olist][*]After triggering the mission, a nearby area with a Danger of 5 or higher will be chosen as the mission target.
[*]Explore the area and enter the Library to fight members of a Research Squad. Face off against the Psychic Agent, a new boss, in the last room.
[*]Defeat the Psychic Agent and complete the mission to receive a special piece of armor with the "Psychic Agent" modifier. Clear the mission on Hard mode or a higher difficulty to unlock the secret playable class "Psychic Agent" (female only).[/olist]
Complete the mission to trigger a special event — Brain Implant.[/quote]
[i]Psychic Agent[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/28c2aff1bc870c091257329c0e02f110de470e61.png[/img]
[b]Skills[/b]
[quote]Soul Steal
Deal damage to an enemy and inflict Stun, Jam, or Silence. Steal a portion of the target's HP and Morale. Skill effect increases for each point of difference in Intelligence.
Terrorize
Deal damage to an enemy and inflict Stun, Jam, or Silence. Steal a portion of the target's Morale.
Brain Bite
Steal a portion of a target's Intelligence and Resolve over time. Skill effect increases for each point of difference in Intelligence.[/quote]

[b]- 5 new rare recipes: Mending Stew, Radiant Cocktail, Fermented Juice, Queen's Decaburger, Fungi Soup. Each offers relatively strong positive and negative effects.[/b]
[quote]Mending Stew: Strength +10, Resist Injury -15%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/d9415dda8a98de13e86da637d392c4b854e653f7.png[/img]
Radiant Cocktail: Agility +10, Loot -15%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/43ad5b168bac1b07884af7998db822fce9e0f76a.png[/img]
Fermented Juice: Intelligence +10, Morale -15%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/ff2d74392bac29f5d3efd688ab6919a4c95c61ba.png[/img]
Queen's Decaburger: Fitness +10, Supplies Cost +30%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/f97657e93e34fd60fa1b706c211b8263d26d6cd5.png[/img]
Fungi Soup: Resolve +10, EXP -30%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/f1cd49e5e88ed1370a69203580245ec025d0e678.png[/img][/quote]
[b]- New mail: World powers which have a good relationship with the Revolutionaries will offer obsolete gear for sale at a large discount.[/b]
[quote]A stronger relationship with a world power increases the chance they will make an offer. Offers include 1 to 3 weapons, armor, trinkets, or medicine at a 20% to 40% discount.[/quote]
[b]- 1 new enemy squad - Research Squad[/b]
[quote]Research Squads can include Bio Soldiers, Surgeons, Daisy Mercs, Pharmacists, Chemists, Engineers, Radiation Engineers, and Signal Officers.[/quote]
[b]- Optimized auto fight logic, including an independent toggle for fighters' 3 skills and their auto use settings.[/b]
[quote]Check the Auto Settings menu in the upper right of fighters' avatars to enable and disable auto use of skills.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/80ab2251ae43a1b860a57f7dcdf6dd4cd3b70f58.png[/img]
[b]- Adjusted and enhanced effects of the Chemist's skills.[/b]
[quote]Increased Chemical Spray damage.
Increased healing effect and duration of Rapid Healing.
Removed Silence from possible random effects caused by Rage Injection.[/quote]
[b]- Adjusted and improved effects on special gear earned as rewards from all missions.[/b]

[b]- Fine-tuned reward values of some events.[/b]

We wish you continued success on your journeys through Home Behind 2!

Producer
ZPP

notes.title: Version Update 1.0.2f0
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

The August update is now available. We are also excited to announce our participation in Steam Survival Fest 2022!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/467960

Home Behind 2 will be on sale at a 30% discount during this Steam event. If you already own the game, this is a great chance to gift it to your friends!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18800/_/

The v1.0.2f0 update includes:

— [b]3 new jobs and fresh enemy squads that include them[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Radiation Engineer[/b]
The radioactive weaponry utilized by this engineer is terrifying, not only permanently weakening enemies in battle but also reducing their ability to recover.

[b]Skills[/b]
Nuclear Grenade
Deal damage to all enemies, decrease all of their stats, and slightly decrease their Heal Effect.

Depleted Uranium Bomb
Deal damage to an enemy and decrease all of their stats.

Irradiated Smoke
Deal damage to all enemies and greatly decrease their Heal Effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/435318c4332d304ab6a58f215731022731761343.png[/img]
[*][b]Signal Officer[/b]
Signal Officers provide their allies with reliable intel while interfering with enemy communications to send them spiraling into chaos.

[b]Skills[/b]
Important Intel
Target the ally with the highest damage, then increase their Accuracy and Crit Rate.

Signal Flare
Target the enemy with the highest damage, inflict Jam or Silence, and then Mark them.

Radio Interference
Inflict Jam, Silence, or Stun on all Marked enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/207b0c8e311d6804a60ae80e0750e30dc603d309.png[/img]
[*][b]Cook[/b]
Although many military chefs lack true culinary skills, their mess call can be more satisfying to hear than the horn of victory.

[b]Skills[/b]
Scrumptious Meal
Heal all allies, then increase all of their stats and Heal Effect.

Biscuits
Heal the ally with the lowest HP, then increase all of their stats and Heal Effect.

Energy Drink
Target the ally with the highest Morale, then increase all of their stats and Morale.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/99d5d461f955b545a8b433b98548c7019ad9baa5.png[/img]
[/list] 

— [b]3 new area features[/b]	
[list]
[*]Trade Center: Trade resources freely at low cost. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/5c468d15dfa3e6a16754508ff81b2149e996b5a3.png[/img]
[*]Clearance: Most items in this area are sold at a discount. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/2c027754bb28cc13efb75ea858391dd3754dd41a.png[/img]
[*]Hyperinflation: Prices of most items in this area have soared.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/3b986459b2fbf3c4915519106b32f570869cfecb.png[/img]
[/list] 

— [b]2 new news events[/b]: Car Bomb and Army Corruption
 [quote][b]Car Bomb[/b]
In recent days, a spree of car bombs have detonated across cities controlled by the Scarian Army, apparently targeting railway stations, police stations, markets, and government buildings. Many civilians and soldiers have been killed. While the government's spokespeople claim that the Revolutionaries are to blame, the Revolutionaries counter that the attacks are false flags planned by Akadullah to strike fear in Scarian hearts.

[b]Army Corruption[/b] (Day 45 or later)
Recent reports state that "Akadullah is furious" over rampant corruption in the highest levels of his Army. Some of his soldiers have been actively avoiding combat and retreating from confrontations with Revolutionaries. There are even whispers of a "whitelist" - a list of anti-government combatants who are to receive special treatment from the Army, such as being spared from heavy firepower and elite squadrons.
 [/quote]

— [b]2 new camp events[/b]: Scrapped Vehicle and Comrade's Request
 [quote][b]Scrapped Vehicle[/b]
XX was fortunate enough to stumble upon a scrapped vehicle from an unknown local fighting force. We may be able to salvage some valuable parts from its shell.

[b]Comrade's Request[/b]
XX wishes to temporarily leave the team to handle some personal affairs with an "old acquaintance" in the area. While they are reluctant to discuss their true intentions, whether they are sending a gift or a barrage of bullets is none of your concern. [/quote]

We appreciate your continued love and support for Home Behind 2! As always, we will continue to follow our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1220010/announcements/detail/3106916883155694882]published development roadmap[/url], and are on track to release another update this coming November.

Producer
ZPP

notes.title: Version Update 1.0.1 f0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! May's update has arrived as scheduled. Here are the details of the 1.0.1 f0 update:

-[b]Improved the generation logic of Army Fortification and Battle wreckage[/b]
[quote]Added the generation of traps/mines near Army Fortification[/quote]
- [b]Added random Army defensive positions[/b]
[quote]A random event that is randomly generated by a combination of enemy troops, mines, traps, wire fences, corpses, and treasure chests[/quote]
- [b]The traveling merchant is more likely to carry rare items[/b]
[quote] Now there is a 12.5% chance of the following options available at the traveling merchant, from which you may get items of a higher grade than the normal ones.
Buy rare weapon
Buy rare armor
Buy rare trinkets
Buy rare medicine
Buy rare Blueprint
Buy rare vehicle weaponry
Buy rare recipe[/quote]
- [b]Added missionaries NPC and their generation logic[/b]
[quote][b]Missionaries[/b]
This sect has their own militia who ensure the safety and stability of their faith and home. They have long declared their neutrality, and continue to act in good faith with both the government and the Revolutionaries.
[b]Donate[/b]
Spend a moderate amount of money to gain the favor of the Order.
[b]Say a prayer[/b]
Spending a small amount of money is equivalent to "Make a sacrifice" to a random god.
Buy medicine
Buy trinket[/quote]
- [b]Added tribesmen NPC and their generation logic[/b]
[quote][b]Tribesmen[/b]
The people in this tribe still maintain their ancient traditions and way of life: tending herds, fishing, hunting, and going to war. Their ancestral homeland is shrinking, more and more of their land being taken during the war. They are no friends of the government - or the Revolutionaries.
[b]Donate[/b]
Spend a moderate amount of money to gain the favor of the Tribe.
[b]Divination[/b]
Performing a divination increases or decreases team morale according to the divination results.
Buy supplies
Buy weapon[/quote]
- [b]Added more interactive elements to some events[/b]
[quote]Added corpses and treasure chests for random events like Battle Wreckage and defensive positions that can be clicked to obtain resources.[/quote]
- [b]Added new mechanic for vehicle weapons - Slow[/b]: Greatly reduce speed of enemy vehicles

- [b]Added 3 vehicle weapons[/b]: Thermal Sniper, Acid Launcher, Aerosol Launcher. Nail Gun adds slow effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/2f66df6d1caf0525b2ea183aac3c2f2f1711c294.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/d8e8fe41d6f73d30879a2dae1dd7d0685b21d56a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/fe78b6248272b07918539ca6b8e1566e9eaa4e07.png[/img]

- [b]Added 4 new tactics[/b]: Conceal Casualties, Heroism, Collectivism, Pointed Strikes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/f8da42c212bd618a2582637b86e39951380c8722.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/b8620635211db82be7e89a7a6c0a5a2c4309b869.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/a759ec7ce66a88a0725faf984b7ea06cb567ddd8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/47c2be98c136888cf31ef0eea4012995b8eff5b5.png[/img]

-[b]Added Agent Gamma to the Collection and improved Gamma's collection and background[/b]
[quote]Codenamed Gamma, one of Akadullah's elite personal guards, graduated third of her class at the Woman's Military Academy in Scaria. Her real name and family history are unknown.

According to intelligence, her incredible survivability and oppressive combat techniques make her the perfect hunter to track down Revolutionaries.[/quote]
-Added [b]Autoplay[/b] function to the plot dialogue

- Forging failure will now refund [b]25% of material consumption[/b]

- Slightly increased the spawn rate of indoor tactical boxes

- Adjusted the skill data of some new jobs (Mainly [b]increased the strength of Machine Gunner)[/b]

- [b]Added Steam Community Items[/b]: Badges, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, and Emoticons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/2081075b4378896ef043faca3f08f571faf9bb8f.jpg[/img]

- Some feature optimizations and bug fixes

We will continue to improve Home Behind 2 according to the roadmap. Thank you for your tolerance, support, and love for the game!

Producer
ZPP

notes.title: 0.8.0 Free Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/9dee509b07b2e7c29e7e5b3aadedbd029c6312f9.jpg[/img]
On March 26th, the new jobs, new skills, and new improvements of Home Behind2 are officially launched!

[b]
New side mission
New jobs debut[/b]

This version update will add a new important side mission which is finding the missing CSB(Civic Security Bureau) agent ‘King’. 

After clearing this side mission, you can obtain special weapons, special armor, and unlock a new Boss class-Special Service Pioneer. This occupation belongs to the special combat unit of the Civic Security Bureau, and each vanguard has been selected and rushed to the most dangerous missions.

In addition, 3 Daisy faction Jobs will be added.
[b]Agent Daisy[/b]: The basic combat unit of the Daisy Company, which is also common in the mercenary market. It is good at operating micro drones for interference shooting
[b]Pharmacists[/b]: Most of them serve Daisy Company medical insurance users, and can effectively extend the survival time of the target (charged by second)
[b]Arms dealer[/b]: Daisy’s salesperson is generally not good at frontal combat, but can provide teammates with long-lasting and significant weapons and armor enhancements at critical moments

[b]Renewal of skills
Unlock more strategic gameplay
[/b]
The new jobs have corresponding new skills, and this update will add four new skill mechanisms. With the addition of the new mechanisms, the plasticity of battle teams will be further improved

(1)Summoning: some professions can summon auxiliary units to participate in battle
(2)Purification: Clear all temporary continuous effects on the target
(3)Immunity: Immunity to all subsequent continuous effects
(4)Kill: Get extra special effects when the skill kills the unit

In addition, the career balance in the game has also been adjusted accordingly to unlock more strategic gameplay.

[b]Mass optimization
Upgraded play experience[/b]

The original recruitment system is replaced by an email system, and players will receive various emails such as news, advertisements, job hunting, and promotional information.
Add post-battle damage statistics function.

Producer 
ZPP

notes.title: Test of version 0.8.0 now available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/644e4ee09bbc15bd56113dfd57f41fc8f6f97038.png[/img]
Version 0.8.0 test branch is now open, the following will introduce this test in detail and how to enter the test branch.

Step1
Confirm that you have the game Home Behind2 (not Home Behind2 Demo) in Steam library, right-click on the product name then click Properties...

Step2
In the 'BETAS' tab of the Properties, select [b]publictest-xianfengceshi[/b]

Step3
If you successfully switch to the test branch, the name of the game in the game library will be displayed as Home Behind2 [publictest]
After the update is downloaded, you can enter the full internal beta version.

Note
It is recommended to back up your original game save data before participating in the internal test to prevent accidental loss of progress!
(Archive location: Save folder in Steam/steamapps/common/Home Behind 2/HomeBehind2_Data under the Steam installation directory)

If you encounter problems in this test or want feedback or suggestions, you are welcomed to send an email to support@coconutislandstudio.com

Thank you for your help and feedback on the game.

Producer 
ZPP

notes.title: Version Update 0.7.0 f0 & 0.7.1 f0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/7243ee0da1fa1b812089c06b2d86dfff39ccd154.jpg[/img]
This update mainly made some adjustments based on the current feedback from players and add some new contents. 

[b]0.7.1 f0[/b]
[olist]
[*] Overall adjustment of captive mechanism and probability:
[*] It will now give priority to capturing the enemy with the highest injury, and the higher the enemy’s injury, the higher the probability of success of the capture-up to 20% increase in success rate
[*] Hovering over the small captive icon will display the current enemy character with the highest injury and additional captive probability
[*] The random result of the final prisoner will be displayed at the top of the screen in the form of a success probability bar
[*] Captive failure compensation: every time a captive fails, 10% of the captive's success rate will be added to the next time until it succeeds
[*] Added tutorials about the captive system
[*] Added a new large map of enemy forces: government special forces. Appears after the lowest danger level of 7, the enemy troops in the area will be ultimate strengthened and cannot be captured
[*] Player teams can now run indoors
[*] The original technology in the kitchen that reduces the cost of player supplies by 4% is modified to reduce the cost of player skill upgrades by 5% (the upgraded technology in the archive will maintain the original effect)
[*] The special effect of the grain storehouse to reduce cooking consumption is modified to reduce the consumption of player skill upgrades (the grain storehouse occupied in the archive will maintain the original effect)
[*] Increased the initial level of new characters acquired in high-level areas
[*] Optimized the numerical display logic of damage and recovery, when the value is less than 1, the decimal point will be displayed instead of 0
[*] Reduced the amount of shields generated by the church pastor's ultimate move
[*] Fixed the bug that the event stuck when triggering a big failure
[*] Fixed a bug where the value of the skill barrier effect was wrong
[*] Fixed some UI display errors
[/olist]


0.7.0 f0
[olist]
[*] Added new difficulty level hell and the corresponding clearance achievement Journey to Hell
[*] Three new jobs are added: Great Shield Soldier, Berserker, and Inquisitor. In Haroun’s initial job choice, the Bandit is changed to Berserker
[*] New skill mechanisms: 
(1)barrier (blocking enemy bullets shot at teammates behind them); 
(2)immortality (health cannot be reduced below 1 point); 
(3)stealing (the skill releaser can obtain the attributes lost by the enemy)
[*] Now high-level enemy squads will have tactics and automatically release
[*] Block effect changes to armor multiplied by 2.5 times
[*] Optimize the shield display, now it will display the specific amount of shield and display it in proportion to the character’s HP
[*] According to different difficulty, the attributes of the plot boss have been additionally improved
[*] Add a surrender button for vehicle battles, which will appear after the battle lasting for 30 seconds
[*] The shortcut key of Super Wrench is replaced with W to avoid misoperation 
[*] Mark the side mission which is unlocking the building as a necessary task
[*] Fix the bug where the occlusion of indoor items during battle affected the selection of enemy targets
[*] Fix the bug that the value of the resource trade caravan was not automatically cleared
[*] Fix the bug where some plots might not be triggered because the main mission was completed too quickly
[*] Career balance adjustment: (cannot be effective for existing roles in the archive)
(1)The explosion-proof force's ultimate skill is added a little barrier effect.
(2)The stench of the Tribal Priest's gas increases the life and morale stealing effect.
(3)Spy’s ultimate move increases the life stealing effect
(4)The skill of the Bio Soldier has increased the effect of reducing the enemy’s physique
[/olist]

We will continue to pay attention to the feedback from players, and continue to update the game during Early Access period.
The improvement will including the optimization and adjustment of each game system, the adjustment of the experience and numerical system under several difficulty options, bug fixes, etc.
Thank you for your valuable suggestions and feedback. Looking forward to hearing from you.

You are welcomed to send problems and suggestions to: support@coconutislandstudio.com
